verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex is a SaaS payroll/HR platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only a REST API with OAuth 2.0 and webhooks, which are developer building blocks, not an MCP server. There is no mention of MCP anywhere, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
